names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 august, «Sfântul Cuvios Dositei», with the rank word left off; his own page calls him «Dositei ascultătorul», the obedient one, and the English epithet is taken from that word.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Αυγούστου, «Όσιος Δοσίθεος ο υποτακτικός του Οσίου Δωροθέου», with the rank word and the clause naming his elder left off. The page glosses the name as «δίδομαι + Θεός», the God-given.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 февраля ст. ст., «Досифей Палестинский, прп.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line gives no epithet at all and names him by his teacher instead.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's second heading for 19. фебруар ст. ст., „Преподобни Доситеј.“, with the rank word Преподобни left off. The heading gives no epithet; the obedience the folder's English name is built on is what the body's last sentences are about.

feast.note: The Russian calendar keeps him on this day, where the Greek and Romanian rows on this folder are 13 August; days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 19 февраля names him by his teacher, «ученика прп. аввы Дорофея» (read 3 October 2026).

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 февраля ст. ст. — «Прп. Досифея (VII), ученика прп. аввы Дорофея.»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 august — «Sfântul Cuvios Dositei»

attestations.note: His page carries a life of one sentence and no troparion and no year.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Δοσίθεος ο υποτακτικός του Οσίου Δωροθέου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is the same man the Romanian row already carries on 13 august, and the Greek notice is as short: «Ο Όσιος Δοσίθεος ήταν υποτακτικός του αββά Δωροθέου (βλέπε ίδια ημέρα). Αναδείχθηκε και αυτός στην ασκητική πάλη και αφού έζησε κατά το παράδειγμα του γέροντα του, απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — he was the disciple of abba Dorotheos, who is on the same day; he too proved himself in the ascetic struggle, and having lived after his elder's example he died in peace. The page's cross-reference «βλέπε ίδια ημέρα» ties the two entries together on this one day, which is the ground on which this row and Dorotheos's are read as master and disciple. It gives no year and no century, so no `dates` is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is added.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.03.2026 (19. фебруар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Доситеј.“

floruit.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 19 February: „Живљаше овај млади светитељ у VI веку.“ It gives the century and no year, and calls him young. The folder carried no dates at all before this reading.
